newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks seen slightly lower at open.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks seen slightly lower at open.

text.p: ---------------------MARKET COMMENT-------------------------- * Toronto stocks could slip slightly at the open but should recover and have a positive day as bonds and golds strengthen. * Analysts said the market remains in a strong uptrend.
Toronto stocks could open lower on Friday but should recover and have a positive day as gold prices and bills strengthened, analysts said.

"Our bonds are under slight pressure and the U.S. S&P contract is down slightly, but any negative activity will be limited and I think we are going to close on the plus side," said MMS International technical analyst Katherine Beattie.

"We are in a strong uptrend. Gold and bills are recovering. Both markets hit record closes yesterday," she added. The Toronto Stock Exchange climbed to new heights on Thursday as corporate earnings impressed investors.
The TSE 300 Composite Index overcame early profit-taking on Thursday to end up 19.99 points at 6785.15. The key index also set an intraday high of 6787.37.

In economic news, Statistics Canada said on Friday the preliminary estimate of average weekly earnings for Canadian workers in all industries except agriculture and fishing rose 3.0 percent in May from a year earlier to a seasonally adjusted C$604.56.
